details.text: The invariant imp-2 defined in the differential must have no source, or the source must be this profile, or a profile that this profile imposes (http://hl7.org/fhir/test/StructureDefinition/inv-impose-other vs http://hl7.org/fhir/test/StructureDefinition/inv-impose-source)

The invariant imp-4 has the source 'http://hl7.org/fhir/test/StructureDefinition/inv-impose-missing', which this profile imposes, but that profile could not be found, so the invariant could not be checked

The invariant imp-3 has the source 'http://hl7.org/fhir/test/StructureDefinition/inv-impose-target', which this profile imposes, but the invariant imp-3 in that profile has a different expression ('country.exists()' vs 'city.exists()')
